wisp.router.learned.title: Auto
wisp.router.learned.intro: For each task Auto weighs every harness · model · thinking level. It starts from public benchmarks, then learns from what you pick yourself and how your runs go: merged PRs, thumbs up or down, rollbacks, follow-ups. Balanced runs each model at its makers’ default level or one step up, Best thinks high, Cheap thinks low. A better model that isn’t your habit shows up as a suggestion in the launcher; Auto doesn’t run it on its own.
